newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: SRI LANKA RUPEE ENDS LITTLE MOVED AS MONEY RISES.
newsitem.headline: SRI LANKA RUPEE ENDS LITTLE MOVED AS MONEY RISES.

text.p: The Sri Lankan rupee closed little changed against the dollar on Monday due to high call money rates and a lack of imports, dealers said.
The rupee ended at 58.92 after opening at 58.91, they said.
"The forex market was very thin and confined to a few trade-backed transactions," said a Hongkong Bank dealer."Banks were concentrating on call money which rose sharply."
Overnight call money closed at 13 percent after opening at 10.5, dealers said.
"There is a slight tightness in the money market because some local banks which lend regularly have invested in central bank short-term repos," said a Standard Chartered Bank dealer.
But dealers said the money market tightness should ease later this week due to a number of inward remittances.
The central bank pushed down the dollar on its overseas weakness, fixing buying and selling prices at 58.9050 and 60.0905.
